market_outlook.short_term: Elevated volatility expected. Bond yields near 20-year highs cap equity multiples; oil whipsaws on Iran headlines. US-China truce provides a 2-month calm, but Fed hawkishness and diesel-price warnings keep inflation fears alive. Gold capped below $4,300. Mortgage rates pressure housing. Net: cautious, range-bound equities with sector rotation toward AI and defensives.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex supercycle and ETF consolidation support structural growth in tech and financials. However, persistent inflation, high rates, and geopolitical fragmentation (rare earths, sanctions) cap multiple expansion. Housing affordability remains a 12-month overhang. Biotech M&A and Asia-Pacific travel offer idiosyncratic upside. 60/40 allocation under question; barbell strategies (short-duration bonds + AI equities) likely outperform.
